Title: Read the Labels And Links section and check the mobile labels are "Samsung", "Real Me" and "Moto".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Scroll to Labels And Links. 2. Read the mobile labels.
Expected Result: The labels are "Samsung", "Real Me", "Moto".

Title: Read the laptop links and check "Apple", "Lenovo" and "Dell" point to their official sites.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Read the laptop link texts and addresses.
Expected Result: The links are Apple (https://www.apple.com...), Lenovo (https://www.lenovo.com...) and Dell (https://www.dell.com...).

Title: Click the laptop link "Apple" and check the browser goes to apple.com.

Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Read the addresses of the broken links. 2. Read the error code (e=) of each link.

Title: Request the broken link for the code 400 and check the server answers with an error status.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Steps: 1. Find the link http://www.deadlinkcity.com/error-page.asp?e=400 in the list. 2. Send a request to the link. 3. Read the status code.
Expected Result: The link is in the list and the HTTP status is 400 or higher.
